videos.title: So Much Is Coming to V-Ray
videos.description:
So much is coming to V-Ray. Here is a quick peek at what’s new.
V-Ray 7, Update 5 brings AI deeper into your visualization workflow, and you still make every creative decision. Get context-aware help from the new AI Assistant. Find or generate 3D assets from a single reference image in Chaos Cosmos. Connect AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to your scenes through the new MCP servers.

On the rendering side, there’s a new Cylinder Light and an upgraded Spot Light, new volumetrics with TyFlow Inferno support, and GPU rendering on AMD graphics cards. Vantage, Anima and Veras also get major updates.
